feeds.title: She Can & She Did Blog
feeds.description: She Can And She Did is storytelling platform dedicated to building a community of unapologetic, vulnerable, ambitious, diverse, and unified women by Kelly Roberts. From how to start running and funny running memes to career and family advice and body image and weight loss, sharing our stories can be an incredible vehicle for change. Meet She Can & She Did, the stronger version of the running blog Run, Selfie, Repeat.

feeds.title: Running And The City
feeds.description: Elizabeth Maiuolo, Born and Raised in Buenos Aires, Argentina, Graduated as a Sworn Translator & Interpreter.Moved to Philly in 2001, and to NYC's Upper East Side in 2005. Working in the translation industry / Heart attack in 2004: decided to start running to keep doctors (and their surgeries/pills) away.

feeds.title: Runstreet Blog
feeds.description: Runstreet, led by RRCA-certified running coach Marnie Kunz, is a NYC-based running and fitness events group that offers NYC running coaching, training plans and virtual coaching, and NYC running events.

feeds.title: Coach Corky Runs
feeds.description: Elizabeth Corkum (AKA 'Coach Corky') is one of New York City's top running coaches, personal trainers, and nutritionists. Whether you're looking to run your first mile or your first marathon, Coach Corky will get you there with a solid plan and positive, supportive training.

feeds.title: Ali On The Run Blog
feeds.description: Ali On The Run is a personal blog sharing Ali Feller's running thoughts and experiences of various races and events that she's competed in, as well as featuring guest interviews.

feeds.title: The Cookie ChRUNicles
feeds.description: Running through life while balancing healthy eating and single motherhood.

feeds.title: Hungry Runner
feeds.description: I'm an editor by day, and a blogger and runner by all other hours. I'm here to share the tips and tools you need to feel good about running and eating well!

feeds.title: Dirty Old Sneakers
feeds.description: A blog about running, cycling and swimming and everything that goes with them. Key topics covered are gear reviews, race prep, race reviews, tutorials and marathon.

feeds.title: Race Pace Jess
feeds.description: I'm Jess Underhill, a certified run coach and freelance fitness writer. My mission in life is to help people chase down their personal bests and crush their goals so that they too, can change their perceptions.

feeds.title: Alice in Arcadia
feeds.description: Blogging about the Mom, the Mouse, the Miles, the Meals, & the Memories.

feeds.title: Sweat Out The Small Stuff
feeds.description: An entertaining running blog! Break a good sweat and all of a sudden it's easier to deal with life's 'small stuff'. Don't worry! Just go for a run!

feeds.title: Nark Running & Strength Blog
feeds.description: We specialize in run coaching and personal training for individuals that want to achieve the highest levels of personal performance.

feeds.title: Runningbrina
feeds.description: My name is Sabrina. I'm German and a 32 years old runner. My family and friends call me Brina. That's how I got my name Runningbrina. I'm a competitive runner and running coach and since 2017 I can call myself a marathoner. I'm based in NYC - a beautiful place to live when you're passionate about running.
